scientific_integrity: Proof of an infinite all-subset theorem supplied; stand-alone exhaustive finite checks reproduced. No claim of externally certified correctness or definitive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: The closed formula applies only to the classical labeled Černý automata on at least three states, and to shortest words that strictly enlarge inverse images; it does not classify total-extension or general automaton reset thresholds. Finite checks are corroboration, not the proof. Definitive priority and independent validation remain unresolved.
title: Exact inverse-extension lengths and their distribution in the Černý automata
